fdaDisclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
fdaDisclaimerPlacement: Footer of every page, adjacent to every structure/function claim, and on the product label.
preLaunchDisclaimer: Preliminary formula — doses shown are targets and are not final.
warningSet: Not for use by anyone under 18 years of age.
Not for use by women who are pregnant or nursing.
Consult your physician before use if you have a medical condition, or take any prescription medication — particularly medication affecting blood glucose, mood, or thyroid function.
Discontinue use and consult a physician if you experience any adverse reaction.
Do not exceed one serving per day.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store below 25 °C, away from direct light. Do not use if the seal is broken.
This is a dietary supplement, not a substitute for a varied diet or for medical treatment.
neverPublish: Any reference to prescription weight-loss medication
Language implying a body needs correcting
A dose written without its unit, or a total without a split
Stock illustration, or photography of a product we have not made
Gradient fills on surfaces, buttons or type, and raised shadows on content
Claims of a timeline for results
claimsRule: Any claim about the product must come from the approved-claims list, reviewed by regulatory counsel. If it is not on that list it does not ship — no exceptions for social captions or creator briefs. Wire the list as the source for product-page strings so an unreviewed claim cannot be published.
operational: 21 CFR 101.93 claim notification filed within 30 days of first sale.
FDA facility registration confirmation held from the contract manufacturer.
Product liability insurance bound before first shipment.
Regulatory counsel review of label and first 90 days of ad copy.
Meta and TikTok business accounts age-gated 18+ at account level before any ad runs.
Cookie consent plus CCPA/CPRA controls live from day one (California traffic is immediate).
blocking: Supplement Facts panel must be produced by the contract manufacturer and cleared by counsel. The panel in the designs is a layout draft.
All {policyCount} policies drafted or reviewed by counsel, split into one route each with its own consent record.
Approved-claims list wired as the source of every product-page string.
